notes.title: [VT Harmony on BBIRTHDAY]
notes.content:
To celebrate the release of VT Harmony on Steam this June 2nd some features were added to the photo mode: 

-New special character of VT Harmony 
-New VT Harmony stickers
-Some bugs fixed for a better game experience

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43368634/423fce0cb08eb9eabc6b81ab5e4362faebafd703.jpg[/img]

notes.title: [Regular Update]
notes.content:
-Now you can see the previous dialogues when pausing the game.
-Pause available in boss fights and mazes.
-Added a guest character from another Yun Seven game to photo mode.
-New stickers for photo mode.
-New icons in the episodes in which there is a boss fight.
-When pausing now you can see what episode and part you are playing (available in some episodes for now)
-Fixed some bugs for a better gaming experience.
